instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl, stir well and set aside.
Place chicken between 2 sheets of waxed paper or heavy duty plastic wrap, and flatten to 1/4-inch thickness, using meat mallet or rolling pin.
Coat grill rack with cooking spray; place on grill over coals.
Place chicken on rack and cook 4 minutes on each side, basting frequently with soy sauce mixture.
Transfer chicken to a serving platter and garnish with green onion, if desired.
Yields 4 servings, about 200 calories.

recipes.formatted_text:
<INGREDIENT> chicken breast
<TITLE> Sesame Ginger Chicken
<CUISINE> asian
<DIFFICULTY> easy
<TIME> 30 minutes
<SERVINGS> 4
<INGREDIENTS> 1 Tbsp. sesame seed, toasted; 2 tsp. grated ginger; 2 Tbsp. honey; 2 Tbsp. reduced-sodium soy sauce; 4 (4 oz.) skinned chicken breast halves; vegetable cooking spray; thin green onion strips
<INSTRUCTIONS> 1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl, stir well and set aside. 2. Place chicken between 2 sheets of waxed paper or heavy duty plastic wrap, and flatten to 1/4-inch thickness, using meat mallet or rolling pin. 3. Coat grill rack with cooking spray; place on grill over coals. 4. Place chicken on rack and cook 4 minutes on each side, basting frequently with soy sauce mixture. 5. Transfer chicken to a serving platter and garnish with green onion, if desired. 6. Yields 4 servings, about 200 calories.
<END>

instructions: Lightly brown meat side of chicken breasts.
Lay all 4 chicken breasts, meat side down, in small (8-inch) skillet.
Add enough water, with chicken bouillon, added to just cover chicken.
Add onion over top of chicken.
Sprinkle with tarragon.
Bring to boil and reduce heat to medium.
Cover skillet with well-fitting lid and cook approximately 30 to 45 minutes or until chicken is done. Add a little water if necessary to replace any lost in steam.

ingredients: 1/8 tsp. garlic powder or 1 clove garlic, minced
1 can (10 3/4 oz.) cream of mushroom soup
instructions: In skillet, in 1 tablespoon hot margarine, cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides.
Remove.
In remaining 1 tablespoon hot margarine, cook mushrooms and onion with garlic powder until tender and liquid is evaporated (stirring often). Add remaining ingredients.
Heat to boiling.
Return chicken to skillet.
Cover; cook over low heat 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink, stirring occasionally.
Serves 4.
recipes.formatted_text:
<INGREDIENT> chicken breast
<TITLE> Creamy Chicken And Mushrooms
<CUISINE> american
<DIFFICULTY> medium
<TIME> 30 minutes
<SERVINGS> 4
<INGREDIENTS> 2 Tbsp. margarine; 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves; 1 1/2 c. sliced mushroom; 1 small onion, sliced; 1/8 tsp. garlic powder or 1 clove garlic, minced; 1 can (10 3/4 oz.) cream of mushroom soup; 1/2 c. milk; 2 Tbsp. dry sherry (optional); 1/8 tsp. pepper
<INSTRUCTIONS> 1. In skillet, in 1 tablespoon hot margarine, cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. 2. Remove. 3. In remaining 1 tablespoon hot margarine, cook mushrooms and onion with garlic powder until tender and liquid is evaporated (stirring often). Add remaining ingredients. 4. Heat to boiling. 5. Return chicken to skillet. 6. Cover; cook over low heat 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink, stirring occasionally. 7. Serves 4.
<END>

instructions: Spread rice in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch glass casserole dish. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top.
Lay chicken pieces on top and spoon mushroom soup over all.
Pour water around chicken pieces. Cover with foil and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Take foil off the last 1/2 hour.
Check liquid content and add, if necessary.
recipes.formatted_text:
<INGREDIENT> chicken breast
<TITLE> Chicken Casserole
<CUISINE> american
<DIFFICULTY> easy
<TIME> 30 minutes
<SERVINGS> 4
<INGREDIENTS> 1 1/2 c. uncooked rice; 1 envelope onion soup mix; 1 can cream of mushroom soup; 1 1/2 c. hot water; 8 chicken breasts or thighs
<INSTRUCTIONS> 1. Spread rice in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch glass casserole dish. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top. 2. Lay chicken pieces on top and spoon mushroom soup over all. 3. Pour water around chicken pieces. Cover with foil and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Take foil off the last 1/2 hour. 4. Check liquid content and add, if necessary.
<END>
